# Reason codes

<!-- Generated by tools/docgen. Do not edit. -->

Built-in rules, by weight. Weights add up to a 0 to 100 risk (default: challenge at 35, block at 75). A floor rule is proof rather than evidence: risk never drops below its weight, and no challenge can clear it. Sites can change mode and weight per rule, or add their own, in the dashboard.

| Code | Weight | Floor | Description | When | Unless |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `REPLAY_CANVAS_SEED` | +90 | yes | A fingerprint captured with one nonce was replayed with another | `net.canvas_seed_conflict == 1` |  |
| `AUTOMATION_WEBDRIVER` | +80 | yes | navigator.webdriver is true (the browser declares it is automated) | `auto.wd == 1` |  |
| `IP_DROP_LIST` | +70 | yes | Request from a network on the Spamhaus DROP list | `net.ip_drop == 1` |  |
| `HEADLESS_UA` | +60 | yes | HeadlessChrome in the user agent | `auto.headless_ua == 1` |  |
| `UA_ENGINE_MISMATCH` | +60 |  | JavaScript engine contradicts the claimed browser | `(fp.ua_family in ['firefox'] && auto.eng in ['v8','jsc']) \|\| (fp.ua_family in ['chrome','edge','opera','samsung'] && auto.eng in ['spidermonkey','jsc'] && fp.os_family != 'ios') \|\| (fp.ua_family == 'safari' && auto.eng in ['v8','spidermonkey'])` | `prof.rfp == 1` |
| `ORIGIN_CHANGED` | +60 |  | Submit came from a different origin than the session | `net.origin_mismatch == 1` |  |
| `AUTOMATION_GLOBALS` | +50 | yes | Known automation framework globals present (cdc_, __playwright, __puppeteer, ...) | `auto.leaks >= 1` |  |
| `UA_CHANGED` | +50 |  | User-Agent changed between session and submit | `net.ua_changed == 1` |  |
| `FP_MULTI_ASN` | +50 |  | One device fingerprint seen from many networks in an hour (proxy rotation) | `vel.fp_distinct_asn_1h >= 5` |  |
| `UA_TLS_MISMATCH` | +45 |  | TLS handshake belongs to a different client than the user agent claims | `net.tls_ua_mismatch == 1` |  |
| `SYNTHETIC_EVENTS` | +40 |  | Most input events were dispatched by script (isTrusted false) | `beh.untrusted_frac >= 0.5` |  |
| `SUBMIT_TOO_FAST` | +40 | yes | Submitted less than 40 ms after the session was issued (no real collection happened) | `t.elapsed_s < 0.04` |  |
| `UA_HEADER_JS_MISMATCH` | +40 |  | User-Agent header differs from navigator.userAgent | `net.ua_hdr_js_mismatch == 1` |  |

| `CLIENT_CLOCK_FORGED` | +35 |  | Client-reported elapsed time exceeds what the server observed | `t.elapsed_mismatch == 1` |  |

Other codes you may see on events:

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `ALLOWLIST_<KIND>` | An allow-list entry matched (ip, cidr, asn, country, fp, ua_regex, crawler, tor); risk forced to 0 |
| `DENYLIST_<KIND>` | A deny-list entry matched; risk forced to 100 |
| `ALWAYS_CHALLENGE_<KIND>` | An always-challenge entry matched |
| `MODEL_ANOMALY` | The learned anomaly model added risk (at most 40, never allow to block) |
| `MODEL:<feature>` | A feature that made the vector unusual for this site (explanation, weight 0) |
| `MODEL_SUPERVISED` | Shadow contribution of the supervised model before it is promoted |
| `CHALLENGE_SOLVED` | Proof of work solved (credit 20) |
| `VISUAL_CHALLENGE_SOLVED` | Visual or audio challenge solved (credit 45) |
| `VERIFIED_CRAWLER_<NAME>` | Edge mode: request from a published crawler range |
